entities.name: Users
entities.rationale: White icon of a group of users at the far left of the whiteboard (around 663,406). Not inside any box; connected to CloudFront with two arrows.

entities.name: CloudFront
entities.rationale: Purple icon labeled 'CLOUDFRONT' at (827,406). Standalone, no container. Sits between users and S3/API Gateway.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Green bucket icon labeled 'S3' at (984,238). Standalone, no container. Connected to CloudFront by a curved arrow.

entities.name: API Gateway
entities.rationale: Purple icon labeled 'API GATEWAY' at (988,410). Standalone, no container. Receives from CloudFront, connects to Lambda and to the authorizer Lambda.

entities.name: Lambda
entities.rationale: Orange lambda icon labeled 'LAMBDA' at (1178,412). Standalone, no container. Backend function connected to API Gateway, EC2 and DynamoDB.

entities.name: Lambda Authorizer
entities.rationale: Orange lambda icon at (994,656) labeled 'LAMBDA' with the heading 'AUTHORIZER' above it. Standalone, no container. Connected to API Gateway by a curved line.

entities.name: EC2
entities.rationale: Orange icon labeled 'EC2' at (1167,243). Standalone, no container. Connected to the backend Lambda by a double-headed curved arrow.

entities.name: DynamoDB
entities.rationale: Blue database icon labeled 'DYNAMODB' at (1188,654). Standalone, no container. Connected to the backend Lambda by a curved arrow.
